Attached: 1 image

WildFly 41 can package the cloud Galleon feature pack into a bootable JAR. I built the full path: a Jakarta EE app, a Podman image, two Kubernetes pods, KUBE_PING discovery, narrow RBAC, and a session handoff that proves replication across both nodes. I also cover the details that can bite later: transaction node IDs, management health on port 9990, and JGroups authentication without traffic encryption. https://www.the-main-thread.com/p/wildfly-41-bootable-jar-kubernetes #WildFly #JakartaEE #Kubernetes #Java
